definitions.scores: self-verbalized, jointly conditioned on all candidates; not token posteriors
definitions.operational: Abstention=2; Macro-F1 labels [0,1], zero_division=0; invalid incurs false negatives
definitions.calibration: Brier/ECE/AUROC/MCC valid responses only; coverage reported
definitions.ranking: binary qrels on fixed judged pool; invalid empty ranking scores zero
definitions.latency: wall time per query, all candidate scores in one call; failures without response have missing latency
definitions.resource: model-specific resident size_vram from api/ps; not peak GPU memory
definitions.uncertainty: Bootstrap captures query sampling uncertainty conditional on fixed model, prompt and corpus
definitions.baselines: Full prepared split only; compare to model groups only when counts are complete
